question: By how many percentage points did the surface fluorine mass ratio fall through the Cyrene-based separation?
rendered: According to the document, the surface fluorine mass ratio of the cathode rejects was 12.49%, and that of the reclaimed cathode powder after the Cyrene-based separation process was 0.14%. Therefore, the surface fluorine mass ratio fell by 12.49% - 0.14% = 12.35 percentage points.
